name: Koishikawa Miku
source:
[b]Bassist of [i]gem of rubble[/i][/b]

A conscientious and slightly strong-willed girl.
Though from a different band than the [url=/c153631]protagonist[/url]'s, she acknowledged their skill after hearing them perform and declared herself their rival—
though in truth, she's less a rival and more just a fan.

[Translated from [url=https://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/lllj/index.html#mainchara]official website[/url]]
